title: I took this sub's advice and somehow ended up with this prototype
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
ayoooo... am I cooking?

Took some advice from this sub and turned it into this prototype.

Cyberpunk monster fights, bullet hell chaos, roguelike upgrades... still very WIP but I think it's starting to show some hope.

Looking for brutally honest feedback. What works / what doesn't?

comments.author: Secret_Slide_1357
comments.body:
It looks cool tbh here's some easy improvements I would add.

1. Impact particules. Blood maybe?   
2. Have the enemy stop for a few ms when hit.  
3. Have icons for the powerups, at least improve the power up screen, it's too bland.  
4. Critical hits maybe?   
5. Have the power ups Icon spawn in the arena?   
6. Special attacks for players and enemy with maybe like a sound or fx as warning. 

keep up the good work.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
all good suggestions. 

question for 6: do you think 2-3 active buttons are acceptable for these type of games?

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body: Buttons aren't really a concern as long as it remains fun and challenging.

comments.author: ND_Jamoose
comments.body: Looks cool. At first I thought you'd say something like roguelike pvp Pong. Some things that can make it more interesting are special shots that bounce off walls, pillars that come out of the ground randomly for a short time and block/bounce shots, special shots like a big one or a machine gun type or maybe one that requires charge up while standing in place for a short time. Maybe a special ability like a shield that triggers for a short time and reflects shot back. Or a shield that absorbs shots for a short time and if absorbed enough it shoots back a big shot (this one's cool because suddenly for a short time you change from dodging to collecting). Also a random powerup that is pushed around by shots so you want to avoid shooting it so it doesn’t reach your opponent. Good luck.

comments.author: ThreadboundDev
comments.body:
I think this is a really neat game idea! It’s like pong but more lasers 😂

I feel like this could learn from anime where your characters are simple and then your abilities can be really stinking cool!

I don’t know if you’ve ever played Raiden but it gives those vibes. Also this could have pvp potential?

My last thought would be like a super/ultimate gauge and maybe like a come back buff?  (X factor from marvel fighters?) 

I think you cooking friend!

comments.author: Calm-Bumblebee952
comments.body: you need game feel something like screen shake and I do not know maybe hit flash

comments.author: metalblessing
comments.body:
Its a good start. I like it. I havent played the web build yet, but it looks like a neat game. Actually very slightly reminds me of my first game I released (not the same but it was a roguelike bullethell shooter focused on insane ability/bullet pattern combos)

Maybe mine can give you some ideas. For mine I had like 130 different abilities that would affect bullet pattern, speed, amount etc, but they all stacked with no limit so it could quickly turn into a lag fest, because breaking the game can be part of the fun. 

If it gives you some inspiration though great, I think only a few people actually played it. You can search for "Mallard Vice" on [itch.io](http://itch.io) if you want to check it out. I feel it might give you some ideas.

On mine every few levels you would have powerups in the arena to give you random abilities. Difference on mine was it was not 1v1.
